brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — clean bill of health: Flowers fully cleared, Tuten stays clean, nothing to change
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — earliest kickoff is Sunday 10:00 AM PT (Herbert/Hampton vs ARI)
Lineup: no changes. Flowers (hamstring) was upgraded to full practice Friday and carries zero injury tag now — no more discount, he's a clean start into IND's soft pass D. Tuten wasn't even on Jacksonville's injury report; his backup LeQuint Allen is a game-time call and only grows Tuten's role if he sits. Downs (calf) is fully clear too. Everyone else unchanged from mid-week.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Stafford's Thursday nightmare is already banked (15/25, 155 yds, 1 INT, 0 TD in a 27-7 loss), rest of the lineup is clean for Sunday
Do now: nothing needs a change
Locks next 24h: none — Stafford and the 49ers DEF already played and are final; the rest of the lineup kicks off Sunday
Lineup: no changes. Etienne's workload is safe regardless of Kamara, who's still just limited in practice — Kellen Moore has already handed him the workhorse job. Judkins remains the week's toughest matchup (16.0 implied) with no better flex option, so he stays in. Wilson's Nashville forecast is now clean (93°F, light wind, no heat flag). Everyone else holds.

FYI: Chase Brown starts in both leagues facing a tougher-than-expected 5th-ranked TB run defense; four Jacksonville pieces are rostered across the two leagues (Strange, Tuten, Jaguars D/ST, Parker Washington); Cleveland's Dylan Sampson is a passing-down complement to Judkins, not a threat to his role.

waivers.text:
SLEEPER — TE is still the priority: you roster zero backup there, and Strange shares Week 7's JAX/LAC bye cluster with Herbert, Hampton, Tuten, and your DEF. FAAB budget is untouched at $100 (nobody in the league has spent a dollar yet) and you sit waiver position 3.
1. Darren Waller (TE, CAR) — Carolina's TE2 on the depth chart behind Tommy Tremble but the far more proven player with real path to the job. Drop Fernando Mendoza (your QB3, confirmed as Vegas' backup behind Kirk Cousins — zero standalone value). FAAB $9.
2. Samaje Perine (RB, CIN) — the direct backup to Chase Brown, who anchors your RB1 slot in BOTH leagues; this is bye-week and injury insurance you don't currently have anywhere on either roster. Drop Zachariah Branch (WR, no role in ATL). FAAB $7.
3. Justice Hill (RB, BAL) — locked in as Derrick Henry's clear #2 and the passing-down back in a full-PPR league; real standalone flex value. Drop Zavion Thomas (WR, no role in CHI). FAAB $6.
4. AJ Barner (TE, SEA) — second TE flier if you miss on Waller or want a true pair. Drop Michael Wilson (WR, buried behind Marvin Harrison Jr./Trey McBride in the ARI target mix, no path to a role). FAAB $4.
5. Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) — cheap speculative stash in a muddled Bears backfield. Only add if you're willing to also cut Woody Marks or Stefon Diggs — your 6 bench spots are full once picks 1-4 land. FAAB $3.
No DEF/K stream needed this week — Aubrey and the Jaguars D&ST both carry plus Week 1 matchups per the Analysis tab.

YAHOO — still no access to the Yahoo free-agent pool this run (private league, no login, screenshots only). Isaiah Likely being confirmed healthy lowers urgency at TE, but Chig Okonkwo remains a thin TE2 if you want a stopgap plan. Drop a fresh screenshot of the free-agent list (Players > Available, filtered by position) into the War room Drive folder and next run can give you real availability and bid guidance.

trades.text:
SLEEPER — send Stefon Diggs to Grandmasterfabe ("Master Bate$ LaPortapotty") for Jake Ferguson (TE, DAL). Diggs is stuck behind Higgins, Flowers, and Downs on your bench with no path to starting reps; Grandmasterfabe is stacked at WR (Olave, DeVonta Smith, Jameson Williams, Jakobi Meyers, Alec Pierce) but is rolling with rookie Harold Fannin as their only real TE, with Ferguson buried as insurance. Diggs gives them a proven bye-week/injury-fill starter; you turn a fully blocked bench piece into the backup TE you currently have nowhere on the roster, which matters with Strange sharing the Week 7 JAX/LAC bye cluster. It's a mild overpay in raw value on your side, justified by how scarce TE depth is around this league right now — nobody scanned so far is sitting on two startable options. Checked your Weeks 15-17 outlook first: Diggs isn't projected to be a playoff starter behind your current WR corps, so moving him costs you nothing down the stretch.

YAHOO — no trade idea this run. I don't have visibility into other managers' rosters or trade blocks in your private Yahoo league (screenshots only cover your team and this week's opponent), so I can't responsibly name a real deal. No trade.txt found in the War room folder either.

news.headline: Zay Flowers upgraded on Baltimore Ravens' Week 1 injury report
news.summary: Flowers was upgraded to full participation on Friday after being limited earlier in the week with a hamstring issue, clearing him for Sunday's opener at Indianapolis.

news.headline: Bhayshul Tuten, Chris Rodriguez, LeQuint Allen All Face Week 1 Jaguars RB Problems
news.summary: Tuten was not on Jacksonville's Week 1 injury report at all, confirming the illness that sidelined him midweek is fully behind him.

news.headline: How the Jaguars Can Answer Week 1 Injury Questions for Cole Van Lanen, LeQuint Allen
news.summary: Allen (hip/soft-tissue) didn't practice Wednesday and head coach Liam Coen said he'd be "pleasantly surprised" if Allen is ready, making him a game-time decision Sunday and a boost to Tuten's workload if he sits.

news.headline: Is Alvin Kamara Playing in Week 1? Saints Injury News Comes With Questionable Status
news.summary: Kamara remained a limited practice participant Thursday with the knee injury and is trending toward a game-time call, but Kellen Moore has already named Travis Etienne the clear workhorse back regardless of Kamara's status.

news.headline: Colts' Josh Downs: Practices fully
news.summary: Downs practiced without limitation this week and carries no injury designation into Sunday's opener, though Indianapolis's addition of Keenan Allen and Alec Pierce's snap share are worth watching for his target share.

news.headline: Chargers' Keaton Mitchell injury may open a desperately needed door for Kimani Vidal
news.summary: Mitchell (hamstring) was limited again at Wednesday's practice, so the Chargers' backup RB picture behind Hampton stays muddled between Mitchell and Vidal — no change to Hampton's workhorse role.

news.headline: Rams vs. 49ers takeaways: Matthew Stafford pulled late in blowout loss for L.A.
news.summary: Stafford finished 15-of-25 for just 155 yards with an interception and no touchdowns as San Francisco's defense throttled the Rams 27-7 in the season opener in Melbourne.

news.headline: 49ers Open 2026 With 27-7 Win Over Rams in Melbourne; Takeaways from #SFvsLAR
news.summary: San Francisco's defense held the Rams to 7 points, intercepted Stafford, and recovered a Fred Warner-forced fumble (Keion White) in a dominant season-opening win.

news.headline: Browns roster: RB depth chart and expectations
news.summary: Judkins sits atop Cleveland's RB depth chart with Dylan Sampson working as the passing-down back behind him — a role split that doesn't threaten Judkins' early-down and goal-line volume.
